definition: Public reconstruction of the existing maintenance covenant applicable at the projected closing absent another qualifying acquisition step-up.
numerator: Consolidated Funded Indebtedness less permitted netted cash under the agreement
cash_netting: Existing agreement permits defined cash netting, but the eligible amount is not determinable from approved public evidence.
inclusions: Agreement-defined funded debt, subject to exclusions and definitions.
exclusions: Items excluded by the agreement; exact public compliance calculation unavailable.
pro_forma_rules: Agreement-defined pro forma rules; not reconstructed as an official calculation.
exceptions: No additional exception assumed from public evidence.
stepups: Qualifying-acquisition step-up may apply only if elected and supported.
draw_condition_effect: Existing draw conditions apply; formal drawability is not reconstructed.
reporting_requirement: Existing reporting terms; current private compliance certificate required.

definition: Gross total funded debt divided by lender EBITDA; no cash netting.
numerator: Term principal + drawn revolver + other funded debt including the retained $62.619m proxy, subject to final legal drafting
denominator: Lender EBITDA using the Phase 2 owner-reviewed base as the opening reference and a documented proposed definition thereafter
inclusions: Borrowed money, drawn revolver and finance-lease/other funded debt.
exclusions: Operating lease liabilities and trade payables unless final legal drafting expressly includes them.
pro_forma_rules: Pro forma acquisitions and dispositions only with delivered calculations and no unsupported synergies.
cures: No financial cure assumed; any administrative cure requires final drafting.
draw_condition_effect: An uncured breach is proposed to block new drawings, subject to final legal drafting.
reporting_requirement: Quarterly certificate within 45 days; annual certificate within 90 days.
limitations: A 3.50x gross covenant is not directly comparable with the existing 3.25x net covenant. Final debt and EBITDA definitions require counsel and lender approval.

cures: No financial cure assumed; any administrative cure requires final drafting.
limitations: Step date aligns to the FY2028 testing year; exact certificate date and stub-period treatment require drafting.

cures: No financial cure assumed; any administrative cure requires final drafting.
limitations: The final test before maturity must not imply refinancing availability.

definition: LTM lender EBITDA divided by LTM cash interest paid or payable on funded debt.
denominator: LTM cash interest paid or payable, including default interest and recurring cash financing fees when known
testing_frequency: quarterly and at closing when a complete LTM denominator is delivered
inclusions: Cash interest on all funded debt and recurring cash financing fees.
exclusions: Noncash amortization of financing fees unless paid in cash.
pro_forma_rules: Acquisition pro forma EBITDA only under the same documented leverage rules.
cures: No financial cure assumed; any administrative cure requires final drafting.
draw_condition_effect: An uncured breach is proposed to block new drawings, subject to final legal drafting.
reporting_requirement: Quarterly certificate and monthly cash-interest reporting.
limitations: The Phase 6 model lacks a complete closing-date LTM cash-interest denominator; opening compliance is therefore not determinable from public information.

definition: Unrestricted eligible cash plus undrawn revolver capacity that is legally and operationally drawable.
numerator: Eligible cash + revolver commitment - drawn revolver - outstanding LCs
testing_frequency: monthly and upon any distribution, acquisition, or additional debt
cash_netting: Eligible cash only after entity, jurisdiction, tax, lien and operating-need validation.
inclusions: Unrestricted cash and available, drawable revolver capacity.
exclusions: Trapped, restricted, pledged, required operating, or otherwise unavailable cash.
pro_forma_rules: Tested after the proposed transaction or distribution.
exceptions: No exception assumed beyond the defined eligible-cash rules.
draw_condition_effect: Failure is proposed to block new drawings and restricted payments, subject to final legal drafting.
reporting_requirement: Monthly liquidity certificate within 15 days; immediate notice at or below the $75m warning.
limitations: The Phase 7 model gives no credit to book cash; final eligible cash remains pending information.

definition: Earlier lender intervention threshold using the proposed gross debt and lender EBITDA definitions.
testing_frequency: monthly monitoring and quarterly formal calculation
draw_condition_effect: Does not itself determine legal drawability.
limitations: A warning is not a covenant breach, waiver decision, or compliance certificate.

testing_frequency: monthly monitoring and quarterly formal calculation
draw_condition_effect: Does not itself determine legal drawability.
limitations: A warning is 0.25x inside the proposed covenant.

testing_frequency: monthly monitoring and quarterly formal calculation
draw_condition_effect: Does not itself determine legal drawability.
limitations: A warning is 0.25x inside the proposed covenant.

metric_or_term: minimum EBITDA to cash-interest coverage warning
definition: Early intervention threshold inside the proposed coverage covenant.
testing_frequency: monthly monitoring and quarterly formal calculation
draw_condition_effect: Does not itself determine legal drawability.
limitations: A warning is not a legal breach.

definition: Early intervention threshold above the proposed minimum-liquidity covenant.
draw_condition_effect: Does not itself determine legal drawability.
limitations: The committed Phase 6 $50m warning remains preserved in prior outputs; Phase 7 adds a more conservative $75m intervention threshold.

definition: Minimum operating cash retained before optional debt repayment in the model.
inclusions: Operating cash retained in the modeled entity perimeter.
exclusions: No assumption that the amount is eligible for covenant netting.
draw_condition_effect: Separate from covenant drawability until documented.
reporting_requirement: Monthly cash report by entity and jurisdiction.
limitations: Do not combine this cash floor with the $50m liquidity covenant or count it as an accessible closing contribution.

definition: 50% of positive annual excess cash flow after specified operating and mandatory financing uses, applied after revolver repayment.
numerator: CFO-equivalent cash generation less cash taxes, ordinary-course capex, working-capital uses, cash interest, scheduled term amortization and retained mandatory obligations
drawn_revolver_treatment: Revolver must be repaid before term sweep.
exclusions: No deduction for dividends, repurchases, voluntary acquisitions, unverified synergies, or unavailable cash; no duplicated deduction for amounts already included in CFO-equivalent cash generation.
pro_forma_rules: Acquisition/disposition pro forma effects require delivered evidence.
exceptions: Subject to the $50m usable-liquidity safeguard and $25m operating cash floor.
reporting_requirement: Annual ECF certificate and calculation within 90 days after fiscal year-end.
limitations: Phase 4-6 modeled sweeps remain sensitivities. Final legal ECF definitions and recurring fee treatment are pending.

definition: No debt-funded share repurchases; no share repurchases while any revolver borrowing is outstanding; dividends require pro forma tests.
testing_frequency: at each payment and monthly monitoring
inclusions: Ordinary dividends only if no default, gross leverage <=3.00x and usable liquidity >=$75m after payment.
exclusions: Share repurchases outside the stated tests; debt-funded distributions.
pro_forma_rules: Pro forma after giving effect to payment.
exceptions: No exception assumed beyond a tightly bounded lender-approved basket.
draw_condition_effect: Warning suspends repurchases; breach suspends all restricted payments.
reporting_requirement: Monthly distribution report and board approvals on request.
limitations: Phase 7 does not take cash-flow credit for these restrictions; Phase 6 unmitigated cash paths remain unchanged.

definition: Incremental debt and acquisitions require pro forma covenant compliance and a warning-level cushion.
exclusions: Unapproved acquisition debt, unrestricted-subsidiary leakage and unsupported synergy credit.
pro_forma_rules: Full pro forma sources, uses, integration costs and LTM EBITDA bridge required.
exceptions: Documented ordinary-course baskets only; no broad exception assumed.
draw_condition_effect: Failure blocks the transaction; it does not create modeled proceeds.
limitations: Basket sizes, permitted liens and legal mechanics remain subject to owner, lender and counsel review.

definition: No equity cure, waiver, acquisition step-up or continued drawability is assumed.
drawn_revolver_treatment: New draws blocked after an uncured breach under the proposed convention.
exclusions: Any negotiated cure or waiver not evidenced at the cutoff.
draw_condition_effect: Continued drawability and no-waiver paths remain separate model cases.
reporting_requirement: Immediate breach notice; lender reservation of rights.
limitations: This is an underwriting proposal, not a legal conclusion about the existing or future agreement.

definition: Quarterly financials and compliance certificate, monthly liquidity/working-capital reporting, annual audited statements and control-remediation updates.
inclusions: Liquidity, debt, covenant EBITDA bridge, cash by entity, working capital, capex, distributions, integration and remediation status.
cures: Limited administrative cure only if legally negotiated; no financial cure assumed.
draw_condition_effect: Late reporting is an escalation event; final default mechanics require drafting.
reporting_requirement: Monthly within 15 days; quarterly within 45 days; annual within 90 days.
limitations: The cash-flow control material weakness remains a confidence issue, not a known financial-statement misstatement.
